finding.observedFailure: PowerShell ACL application exceeded the five-second fail-closed operation budget on the protected-main Windows runner.
finding.resolution: Control token ACL creation and verification invoke System32 whoami.exe and icacls.exe paths derived from the loaded KERNEL32.DLL rather than PATH, cwd or mutable SystemRoot. Grant and strict verification bind the current numeric SID, not localized or lossy account display text.

failedAttempts.adversarialFinding: Whitespace-bound display-name suffixes could impersonate the current principal.

evidenceHeadRemediation.windowsFinding: Hosted Windows account display text and icacls path output are not stable security identifiers: qualification rejected a valid hosted spelling, while independent adversarial review proved that a different account containing the current display name as a whitespace-delimited suffix could be accepted.
evidenceHeadRemediation.resolution: whoami is required to emit one exact CSV record whose second field is a bounded numeric SID. icacls grants that SID with the required asterisk form and saves the DACL as UTF-16LE SDDL. Verification accepts exactly one protected DACL with one Allow FullAccess ACE for that exact SID, OI plus CI only for directories, and no other, inherited, deny, GUID or partial-rights ACE. The parser ignores all display-name and target-path spellings. System tools are resolved from the loaded KERNEL32.DLL, so hostile PATH, cwd and SystemRoot values cannot redirect execution.

reviewFocus: icacls argument semantics and partial-failure cleanup
numeric SID and strict SDDL binding
